source_note: NGN. Figures printed in NGN thousands in the audited consolidated statement of cash flows, CHAMS Holding Company Plc annual report for the year ended 31 December 2025, page 14 (Group columns). Rebuilt 2026-11-13: the previous file's columns were shifted against the statement - its FY2025 operating cash flow was the Company 2025 figure and its FY2025 financing cash flow and net movement were the Company 2024 figures. Older columns (FY2023 to FY2021) were dropped rather than carried, because they cannot be reconciled to any printed statement on disk. Every row now ties: operating plus investing plus financing equals the net movement in cash in both years.
audit: Operating -662,131 + investing 290,381 + financing 4,141,462 = 3,769,712 (2025) and 629,751 - 2,045,187 + 785,688 = -629,748 (2024), both matching the printed net movement.
